reviews.x: I’m in love with my ears !!!! Perfectly made, quality construction. Have used on 6 separate trips and they are holding strong. I got so many compliments. Will definitely buy more for the next trip.

reviews.t: I can’t believe these were this cheap!
reviews.x: All I can say is WOW! These ears are amazing quality for the price. If I were to have been handed these ears without knowing where they came from, I would have though these were an authentic Disney product. The shape of the ears are perfect and the fabric on the headband is one of the softest things I’ve ever felt. The ears are sturdy enough that they stay upright but feel light enough on your head that you forget they are there!  I’ll be buying every color!

reviews.t: Perfect for myself and also my 2 year old! One size fits most! Great for Disney On Ice!
reviews.x: We bought these for Disney On Ice, they where super cute and comfortable. The headband it’s self is a velvet material and is soft and does not hurt the back of your ears like other headbands. They aren’t too heavy and they fit my 2 year old girl perfectly and they also fit me perfectly so I would say they are one size fits most. We got the rose gold & pink ones. I posted pictures of how cute they where!
Adorable ears! We purchased the MM ears for our trip to Disney World, unfortunately the cute little bow came detached from the headband (on our third day).

reviews.t: Not perfect but it’s held up
reviews.x: It’s smaller than the standard Disney Parks ears as seen in the photo I put it up against my Christmas ears I actually bought at Magic Kingdom. And the right ear isn’t perfectly round. It’s gone unnoticed in pictures and by everyone else. It’s held up so far in my Disney adventures, so for the price I’m not angry.

Cute! Poorly made. I was able to wear mine twice to Disneyland. Wore fine at the park. But somehow taking it off...having in car bringing in my home. The bow fell off and all it is is hot glue holding it on. Just buy the real Disney ears To the owner: I would recommend sewing on.

I was afraid they were poor quality or looked very cheap, but I was surprised that they were beautiful and almost the same as those sold in the parks for a higher price. They were Perfect for my out fit.
Purchased the pink and original color scheme and it was just as expected! Love the 3D bow, almost like the ones sold at the park. Would recommend instead of the $30 headbands.

These are for my daughter to wear at her birthday party and I am so happy with them. The headband is wrapped in a soft material so it seems like it will be comfortable, but it does slip off (I'll just put some plastic hair ties around the end of it though). I love that the bow and ears aren't just flat - they have some stuffing in them. I will definitely order some other Minnie ears from this seller.
Headbands are usually uncomfortable. This one is certainly not.  You do realize you have it on but does not interrupt normal task or cause headaches. Disney sells the same headband at a higher price.
At first I was skeptical about the ears, but they’re great! Very comfortable and cute. Reminds me of Piglet colors. Love them 👍🏻 hope the pictures help!
High quality ears are exactly what they sell in the park! Very cute and glittery.

reviews.t: A little tear, but easily fixable
reviews.x: Adorable ears for the price! Shipping was really quick. The headband itself is comfortable with almost a fleece like material. The ears are sturdy (although I think they are a little too close together). The sequins are very great (I thought they would be too flashy but they are not). I am a little sad that the bow on the backside of the headband is torn. I should be able to fix it easily but overall a pretty good deal. Can't wait to wear them at Disney!!!

Such a great pair of ears! Didn’t hurt my head after 2 days of wearing them. Loved them. Sturdy overall but definitely by the end of day 2 they felt a little looser than when I first started wearing them so I started taking them off during some rides so they wouldn’t fall off. Mostly though they stayed put without issue or pain.

These ears were much nicer than I was expecting! Got them to wear for a quick Disney trip with the family over the holidays and I blended right in with all the other ears! They look great - just like real ones that are triple the price! They are comfortable for wearing all day and held up well.

The ears are not round at all. And there is a bit of left over hot glue on them. So disappointing the bow is cute. If I had more time I would just fix them myself but our trip is in a few days. Planning on returning them.

I got these to go to Disney. They are really cute but I had to keep adjusting them. I would have to keep doing it even when just walking around. The material was just to slippery and they wouldn’t stay up.
I wasn't having high hopes on these.. but they were great!! They look well made and feel good. No hurting behind the ears. I bought these for my neices Minnie themed party and they were a standout!
These ears arrived today.  I purchased them to wear for a birthday Zoom chat this weekend.  They are made so well and fit my adult head comfortably.  Definitely worth the price.
Wow so impressed. These aren’t the cheap, thin headbands at all. These are the fluffy ears and the headband doesn’t dig into your head like the ones in the park. 100% worth it
Very good for the price. These will be great for our trip to Disney World. They are well made, feel comfortable and look great. Really loved them plus affordable
Great quality! I bought the pink and white. Wore for a disney trip i was able to leave them on during rides. Super cute and got a lot of compliments.
All around great product! Super comfortable- I hardly noticed they were on and they held up perfectly. I’ll definitely buy more!
Very comfortable, sturdy not flimsy at all, great price. Matched the Piglet shirt perfectly that were also lurched thru Amazon
Quality product, much nicer looking than a lot of the Minnie Mouse eats we saw in Disneyland and for a good price.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the ears as great quality and a good value compared to pricier park versions.
Many customers find the headbands comfortable and soft, suitable for all-day wear.
Several reviewers report durability problems, especially the bow detaching from the headband.
Some note the ears are smaller than standard Disney Parks ears or have minor shape issues.
A few mention the headband slipping or loosening over time.
